]]; न हि दीपौ परस्परस्योपकुरुतः [[Ś. B.]]; so ज्ञानदीपः &c.

__1 the day of new moon (अमा). 
__2 = दीपाली q. v. 
-आराधनम् worshipping an idol by waving a light before it. 
-आलिः, -ली, -आवली, -उत्सवः 
__1 a row of lights, nocturnal illumination. 
__2 particularly, the festival called Diwali held on the night of new moon in आश्विन. 
-उच्छिष्टम् soot, lamp-black.

__1 the flame of a lamp. 
__2 N. of a com. on Yajñavalkya.

.]]

.]]

.]]

.]] A treelike column of building (Mar. दीपमाळ); [[

]]; also दीपपादप (a candle-stick).

__4 the [Page0817-2] tree called devadāru q. v.

.]]

(-पिका f.) [दीप्-ण्वुल्] 
__1 Kindling, inflaming. 
__2 Illuminating, making bright. 
__3 Illustrating, beautifying, making illustrious. 
__4 Exciting, making intense; सामवादाः सकोपस्य तस्य प्रत्युत दीपकाः [[Śi. 2. 55]]; [[

.]] 
__5 Tonic, stimulating digestion, digestive. 6 Skilful in managing a lamp. 
-कः 
__1 A light, lamp; तावदेव कृतिनामपि स्फुरत्येष निर्मलविवेकदीपकः [[

.]] 
__2 A falcon. 
__3 An epithet of Kāmadeva (also दीप्यक). 
__4 N. of several plants (Mar. ओंवा, जिरें, चित्रक, कांदा, मोरशेंडा) 
__5 N. of a Rāga. 
__6 A kind of measure. 
-कम् 
__1 Saffron. 
__2 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech in which two or more objects (some प्रकृत ‘relevant’ and some अप्रकृत ‘irrelevant’) having the same attribute are associated together, or in which several attributes (some relevant and some irrelevant) are predicated of the same object; सकृद्वृत्तिस्तु धर्मस्य प्रकृताप्रकृतात्मनाम् । सैव क्रिंयासु बह्वीषु कारकस्येति दीपकम् ॥ [[K.
]]; cf. वदन्ति वर्ण्यावर्ण्यानाम् धर्मैक्यं दीपकं बुधाः । मदेन भाति कलभः प्रतापेन महीपतिः ॥ [[
